question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Erudite
solution:
The correct answer is **"Knowledgeable."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Erudite"** means having or showing extensive knowledge, learning, or culture. (विद्वत्तापूर्ण, विद्वान)

 
 
• **Example**: *The professor was known for being **erudite**__.*
 
 
 
• **"Knowledgeable"** is a synonym of **"erudite."**
 
• **"Knowledge"** means having a lot of knowledge. (बहुत कुछ जानने वाला, बहुज्ञ, सुविज्ञ)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She’s very **knowledgeable**__ about history.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1, "Naive"**, means showing a lack of experience, wisdom, or judgment. (जिसे जीवन का पर्याप्त अनुभव नहीं और जो दूसरों पर तुरंत विश्‍वास या भरोसा कर लेता है; भोला-भाला)
 
• **Option 3, "Ignorant"**, means lacking knowledge or awareness in general; uneducated or unsophisticated. ((किसी बात से) अनजान, अनभिज्ञ)
 
• **Option 4, "Simple",** means easily understood or done; presenting no difficulty. (समझने, करने या प्रयोग करने में आसान, सुबोध, सुकर; कठिन या जटिल नहीं, सरल)
